dtc_catalog.description_id: [SRS Air Bag System (Bab 8B) - Hal. 1083] Front Air Bag Deployment Record (Manual Resmi Suzuki Ertiga Gen 1)
dtc_catalog.common_causes: S D M; Driver and/or Passenger air bag (inflator); Driver and/or Passenge r seat belt pretensioner; Those initiator circuits.; Kondisi Deteksi ECM: Deployment of front air bag has been recorded in SDM.
repair_steps: 1. Periksa DTC & Freeze Frame Data dengan Scan Tool pada SRS Air Bag System (Bab 8B) (Hal. 1083).

2. Cek fisik konektor, tahanan kabel harness (< 1 Ohm), dan tegangan suplai/ground pada area masalah: S D M; Driver and/or Passenger air bag (inflator); Driver and/or Passenge r seat belt pretensioner; Those initiator circuits.; Kondisi Deteksi ECM: Deployment of front air bag has been recorded in SDM..
3. Ukur tegangan terminal konektor sesuai standar Bab 1A-109 / modul terkait, perbaiki jalur atau ganti komponen bermasalah, lalu hapus DTC.
